Name: Earthy Interface Compatibility for Fishing Overhaul
Author: xkXKxxkk
Description:
About
A lightweight compatibility patch that gives Fishing Overhaul's custom fishing interface the visual style of Earthy Interface.
It automatically applies nine interface textures without overwriting or modifying any original mod files.
Requirements
Fishing Overhaul
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50033]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50033[/url]
DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658[/url]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Installation
Extract the EarthyFishingOverhaulCompat folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, then launch the game through SMAPI.
To uninstall, simply delete the compatibility patch folder. This patch does not modify save data.
Credits
Fishing Overhaul by Raven7s
DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface by DaisyNiko
